data.gender_notes: Anandh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anandh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ananda', which means joy, bliss, or happiness. This name is associated with the divine experience of Ananda-Maya Kali, a form of the Hindu goddess Kali who embodies eternal happiness and bliss. The name Anandh carries the meaning “Joy, Bliss, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anandh usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, bliss, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anandh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Anandh was a name of the Hindu god Vishnu during the medieval period. It was one of the 108 names of Vishnu, and was believed to represent the divine qualities of joy, happiness, and bliss.

Anandh was also the name of a famous Tamil poet, saint and philosopher, who lived during the 8th and 9th centuries. He is considered as one of the Alvars, or the 12 great saints of the Vaishnavite tradition in Tamil Nadu, who composed hymns in praise of Lord Vishnu and his consort Lakshmi.
